claims.text: The resort is on the shores of Lake Austin in Texas Hill Country, approximately 30 minutes from downtown Austin.

findings.quote: Lake Austin Spa Resort is located on the peaceful shores of Lake Austin in Texas Hill Country, approximately 30 minutes from downtown Austin.
